errors.name: PARSE_ERROR
errors.defaultHint: Send one valid UTF-8 JSON-RPC 2.0 object per text frame.

errors.name: INVALID_REQUEST
errors.defaultHint: Send a single JSON-RPC 2.0 request object; call session.hello first.

errors.name: METHOD_NOT_FOUND
errors.defaultHint: Use catalog.search to find the right capability name.

errors.name: INVALID_PARAMS
errors.defaultHint: Fix the arguments listed in data.errors; catalog.describe shows the schema.

errors.name: INTERNAL_ERROR
errors.defaultHint: A host bug; retry later and report the trace id if it repeats.

errors.name: UNAUTHENTICATED
errors.defaultHint: Read the token from GameData/SkizzyProtocol/PluginData/auth.token and send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

errors.name: PERMISSION_DENIED
errors.defaultHint: The user's permission settings forbid this; ask the user to change them in the in-game Permissions window.

errors.name: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
errors.defaultHint: Ask the user to approve the prompt in game, then retry.

errors.name: UNAVAILABLE_IN_SCENE
errors.defaultHint: Switch KSP to one of the scenes in data.required and retry.

errors.name: NOT_FOUND
errors.defaultHint: List current objects again (ksp.vessels.list) and use a fresh handle.

errors.name: BUSY
errors.defaultHint: Retry after data.retryAfterMs.

errors.name: TIMEOUT
errors.defaultHint: Retry, or raise opts.timeoutMs.

errors.name: CONFLICT
errors.defaultHint: The game state conflicts with this call; read data.detail and change the state first.

errors.name: PRECONDITION_FAILED
errors.defaultHint: A precondition in data.reason is not met; fix it and retry.

errors.name: PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.defaultHint: Game or mod code threw; check ksp.log.tail and retry later.

errors.name: CANCELLED
errors.defaultHint: The call was cancelled; start it again if still needed.

errors.name: RATE_LIMITED
errors.defaultHint: Wait data.retryAfterMs before calling again.

errors.name: VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
errors.defaultHint: Request one of the versions in data.supported.

errors.name: LEASE_HELD
errors.defaultHint: Another actor holds this control channel; wait or ask it to release.

errors.name: ROE_VIOLATION
errors.defaultHint: The rules of engagement forbid this action.

errors.name: STALE_DECISION
errors.defaultHint: Re-read the picture and issue the order again with the new seq.

errors.name: BUDGET_EXHAUSTED
errors.defaultHint: The spending cap was reached.

errors.name: SLOW_CONSUMER
errors.defaultHint: Read messages faster or subscribe to fewer streams.

errors.name: NOT_IN_VIEW
errors.defaultHint: The object is not visible to your team under fog of war.

errors.name: EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE
errors.defaultHint: No executor exists for this order type on this install.

errors.name: KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE
errors.defaultHint: The user engaged the kill switch; only read calls work until they release it in game.

errors.name: DUPLICATE_NAME
errors.defaultHint: Choose another name or use the suggestion.

webSocketCloseCode.description: WebSocket close code for a fatal protocol error: 4000 plus the distance of the JSON-RPC error code from -32000, e.g. -32001 closes with 4001.
